# Diesel and DEF – ASE Practice Question (VIDEO)


#### Description


Technician A says that an empty DEF (Diesel Exhaust Fluid) tank can result in a “no start” complaint. Technician B says that the quality of the DEF fluid in the tank should be checked when SCR system faults are noted.


**Who is correct?**
A) Technician A
B) Technician B
C) Both Technician A and B
D) Neither Technician A or B
